response_item.revised_prompt: Revise the newly generated north-facing source component sheet against the ORIGINAL approved 384x416 SOUTH neutral reference shown earlier, not against your own changed proportions. Keep the same conservative costume, anatomical right-hip satchel and back strap. Correct these technical failures: (1) original camera looks DOWN noticeably on the hood and shoulders, whereas your back figure is nearly eye-level; show an elevated orthographic back view with more hood crown/shoulder tops and correctly foreshortened body, (2) preserve original narrow leg/boot proportions and shorter irregular coat tails, not bulky tall boots or a new long symmetrical coat, (3) remove ALL haze, soft glows, drop shadows, translucent background pixels and edge halos; transparent pixels must be truly empty right up to the thin antialiased painted contour, (4) detached torso should end at hips and NOT duplicate the separate coat tails, (5) components must be individually painted with usable overlap margins and anatomically coherent proportions. Same muted charcoal and worn brown painted material, no brighter gold trim, no new buckles or accessories beyond original. Deliver one clean sheet: assembled elevated NORTH neutral on the left, detached matching hood, torso/back strap, left/right upper arms, left/right forearm gloves, left/right coat tails, left/right thighs, left/right shin-boots and right-hip satchel on the right. All parts separated by generous truly transparent gaps, same scale. No text, labels, backgrounds, ground plane, checkers or decorative lighting. This is a source proposal only, not accepted art.
